analysis_role: Post-hoc reviewer-requested uncertainty and marginal-attribution audit. This protocol cannot select, promote, replace, or deploy an artifact.

matched_fpr_uncertainty.interval: Wilson 95% score interval without continuity correction for false-negative rate
matched_fpr_uncertainty.paired_test: Exact two-sided McNemar test on discordant dangerous-transition decisions

definitions.learned_only_collision_avoidance: learned_alert AND NOT deterministic_block AND unshielded_collision
definitions.learned_missed_collision_caught_by_rule: unshielded_collision AND deterministic_block AND NOT learned_alert
